kkahit.title: Koj puas raug tshuaj tua kab?
kkahit.emergency: Yog leej twg ua pa nyuaj, qaug dab peg, los sis tsaus muag, hu rau 911 tam sim no.
steps: Khiav tawm ntawm thaj chaw tshuaj tsuag mus rau qhov chaw cua tshiab.
Hle khaub ncaws thiab khau uas ntub tshuaj tsuag pov tseg.
Muab xab npum thiab dej huv ntau ntau ntxuav tawv nqaij kom txog 15 feeb. Rau qhov muag, muab dej huv yaug kom txog 15 feeb.
Hu rau Chaw Pab Cuam Tshuaj Lom (Poison Control). Nws hu dawb tsis them nyiaj thiab tsis muaj leej twg paub, thiab lawv muaj neeg txhais lus.
Qhia koj tus thawj saib xyuas paub tias yog tshuaj dab tsi. Koj tus tswv hauj lwm yuav tsum tau coj koj mus ntsib kws kho mob.
